classification.name: benchmark-goal contradiction
classification.definition: A benchmark-goal contradiction exists only when all four criteria below are supported by the recorded trajectory and repository evidence.
criteria: The remaining missing import occurs in a test fixture or example that deliberately models an absent dependency, and project semantics explicitly require that module to be absent.
No legitimate dependency expected by the project provides the module.
Eliminating the diagnostic would require changing or excluding repository source, fabricating a local import provider, or otherwise changing the project's intended semantics.
Apart from the contradiction, the submitted program has normally solved every remaining legitimate deployment dependency.

adjudication.official_accounting: If Official fails because of the contradiction, count it honestly as A Official Fail.
adjudication.replay_accounting: Do not count it as a genuine replay opportunity, do not run B for it, and do not use it as an EnvSolve-Pro success example.
adjudication.mixed_failure_rule: If any other legitimate installable dependency remains unresolved, the contradiction label must not hide that deployment failure.
adjudication.uniform_scope: Apply the same criteria to every remaining case in this 15-case stratum without case-specific relaxation or extension.

scientific_invariance: This amendment adds an analysis category. It changes neither the algorithm, hard boundary, A/B treatments, Official metric, fixed case order, nor terminal decision rule.
safeguard_policy: Ordinary Git versioning only; this amendment adds no hash, frozen contract, or software gate.
